failures.failure: The first sha256sum -c invocation was launched from csos_output while manifest entries were rooted at csos_output/.
failures.fix: Reran verification from the extracted artifact root; every entry passed.
failures.prevention: All package verifiers now change to the archive root explicitly before sha256sum -c.
failures.wasted_processing: File-open checks only; no market data, scientific result or package content was changed.

failures.cause: Artifact size 539042664 bytes exceeded the connector limit 536870912 bytes.
failures.failure: The annual Actions artifact could not be downloaded through the connector.
failures.fix: Switched to the twelve preserved monthly artifacts/Release assets.
failures.prevention: Preflight artifact byte size and automatically select monthly packages when an annual package exceeds 512 MiB.
failures.wasted_processing: No partial annual download was retained and no recollection occurred.

failures.cause: Expected SIGPIPE after head closed the pipeline.
failures.failure: A tar listing piped to head exited with status 141 under pipefail.
failures.fix: Inspected members through Python tarfile without a truncating shell pipeline.
failures.prevention: Use bounded tarfile iteration instead of tar|head under pipefail.
failures.wasted_processing: Only the listing command was repeated; no archive extraction or analysis was affected.

failures.failure: Bootstrap failed before data access because PyYAML was assumed present.
failures.fix: Removed the PyYAML check and retained Python compile plus deterministic text assertions.
failures.prevention: Bootstrap validation must use declared dependencies only.

failures.cause: The workflow file was included in its own scan.
failures.failure: The firewall grep matched the workflow own forbidden-source pattern.
failures.fix: Restricted static source scan to the evaluator; runtime receipt still asserts no 2025 access.
failures.prevention: Firewall test fixtures and control text must be excluded from source-reference scans.
failures.wasted_processing: No authority download or analysis occurred.

failures.cause: Result cleaner normalized numpy integers and floats but not numpy booleans.
failures.failure: Scientific computation reached result serialization but JSON writing rejected numpy.bool_.
failures.fix: Added numpy.bool_ to the JSON normalization layer only; no event, candidate, cost, gate or ranking logic changed.
failures.prevention: Schema serialization tests must include every numpy scalar type before full runs.
failures.wasted_processing: One full authority download and approximately three minutes of deterministic calculation were repeated.

failures.cause: Large opaque base64 replacement was not independently round-trip verified after GitHub content upload.
failures.failure: A manually replaced compressed payload did not decode to a compilable source.
failures.fix: Recovered the known-good payload from Git history, applied the one-line bool normalization to plaintext, committed canonical evaluator source, and removed the opaque payload.
failures.prevention: Canonical research source must be stored as plaintext; opaque payloads may bootstrap once but must not remain the maintained source.
failures.wasted_processing: One checkout and immediate compile attempt; no data access.
